Select: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source: molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join: molecule_dictionary parent ON chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1336'; molecule_hierarchy ON parent_molregno = parent.molregno; molecule_dictionary child ON molregno = hierarchy.molregno; compound_structures ON child.molregno; compound_records ON child.molregno; docs ON records.doc_id; activities ON records.record_id; assays ON activities.assay_id; target_dictionary ON assays.tid. Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL279'; activities.standard_type = 'IC50'; activities.standard_units = 'nM'. Sort: compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Limit: None.
